name: GameSupport
author: Alastair M. Robinson

provenance.note: Released by its own author, who describes it in the upload as a previously-unreleased extension published so that his AMRWolf demo could be shared with source. The archive carries the full assembler source (Source/GameSupport.s) and an AmigaGuide manual, so behaviour can be read directly rather than inferred. Slot 23 comes from the guide and the readme, which agree. NOTE the version disagreement: the Aminet readme's Version field says 1.0 while the binary's own $VER cookie says 1.2. The cookie is taken as authoritative, as it is for LDos.
provenance.redistribution: Distribution: Aminet, per the upload's own header, and released by the author himself with source. No licence text ships with it, so the terms beyond Aminet distribution are unstated.

notes: 37 keywords. Author-released with source, which puts it in the small group that could reach faithful without disassembly -- the same tier as AMOS 3D's and JD's. Not ported. The name is a description rather than a product line: it is the handful of routines one game needed, not a general framework.
